title: Explainable Emotion and Mental Health Reasoning in Large Language Models Using Theories of Emotion
abstract: arXiv:2611.29628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a wide range of applications. However, their ability to simulate human-like behavior and reasoning remains unclear. While emotion detection is a better-established Natural Language Processing (NLP) task, existing approaches primarily focus on directly classifying text into predefined emotion classes, often overlooking the appraisal process that explains why an individual experiences a particular emotion in a given situation. In this work, we propose Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought (PsyCoT) reasoning, a theory-driven prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion. We propose and evaluate PsyCoT for subjective NLP tasks, including emotion analysis, emotion intensity prediction, stress analysis, and depression severity identification. translated_title: 使用情绪理论在大语言模型中实现可解释的情绪与心理健康推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.29628v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）的发展使其在广泛的应用领域成为可能。然而，它们模拟类人行为和推理的能力仍不明确。虽然情绪检测是一项较为成熟的自然语言处理（NLP）任务，但现有方法主要侧重于将文本直接分类到预定义的情绪类别中，往往忽略了评估（appraisal）过程——即解释个体为何在特定情境中产生某种特定情绪的过程。在这项工作中，我们提出了基于心理学的思维链（PsyCoT）推理，这是一种以沙赫特-辛格（Schachter-Singer）情绪理论和认知评估理论为基础的理论驱动提示策略。我们提出并在多种主观NLP任务上评估了PsyCoT，包括情绪分析、情绪强度预测、压力分析和抑郁严重程度识别。我们的评估涵盖四个分类复杂度级别：二元分类、多分类、多标签分类和……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于沙赫特-辛格情绪理论和认知评估理论的心理学思维链提示策略PsyCoT，使大语言模型在情绪分析和心理健康任务中实现可解释的推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PsyCoT, a psychology-based chain-of-thought prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion, enabling explainable emotion and mental health reasoning in LLMs.
